articles.title: US stocks edge toward their records after oil prices ease a bit
articles.description: U.S. stocks are holding relatively steady following the latest yo-yo moves for oil prices. The S&P 500 rose 0.3% Monday and pulled within 0.7% of its all-time high set during the summer. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 135 points, while the Nasdaq composite climbed 0.5% and was on track to set its own record. The moves were sharper in the oil market, where the price for a barrel of Brent crude edged down after swinging earlier between $100 and $103. In the bond market, the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 5.29%.
